messages:
Priya N: Quick FYI — while following up on the onboarding guide I hit a 403 for an image: https://assets.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/architecture-diagram.png  (staging screenshot scan shows 403)
Alex K: I saw that earlier, the CDN rehost job didn't pick up that file. Do we know the owner?
Priya N: Checked the doc frontmatter — no custodian listed. Looks orphaned.
docs-bot: [link-scan] automated scan found 403 on 1 asset (path: /docs/onboarding/architecture-diagram.png) — last-checked 2026-03-17
Maya L: I can take ownership + rehost if no one else is queued. Will need a copy of the image from the old bucket or Figma export.
Ben S: Thanks Maya. If you have the path, a quick sed would fix the mdx reference. Example:
```
sed -i 's|https://old-cdn.example.com/onboarding/architecture-diagram.png|/assets/docs/onboarding/architecture-diagram.png|g' content/docs/onboarding.md
```
Sam R: When you open the PR, add `docs: rehost img` to the title and add the runbook tag. I'll review.
Maya L: OK grabbing the file now — if it's missing from the bucket I'll re-export from Figma and rehost under `/assets/docs/onboarding/arch-diagram-v2.png`.
Alex K: If re-exporting, try to keep the filename stable — our caching/deploy tooling references filenames. If you must change it, include a redirect in the doc frontmatter.
Maya L: Got it. I'll keep the path stable; will open PR in ~30m. @Sam R @Alex K plz review when you can :pray:
Sam R: :eyes: will review after lunch
Alex K: :thumbsup: thanks
Priya N: awesome, thanks team — ping here when PR is up so I can resume the onboarding sweep
Maya L: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — title `docs: rehost onboarding arch diagram (fix 403)` — includes sed change + asset upload + redirect frontmatter. Assigning Alex K for review.
Alex K: Reviewing now
Sam R: Quick note — add an entry to the KB runbook under "staging preview checks" so future scans have an owner. Small follow-up PR ok.
Maya L: Will add runbook note in the same PR.
docs-bot: [scan] re-run scheduled in 2h. Current thread will be linked to the ticket #DOCS-178
Alex K: Merged. Deploy passed. :tada:
Priya N: Verified — image loads in staging and the onboarding flow passes the QA checklist. Closing this thread.
Maya L: Thanks all!
